title: Expand compiled road world to all five boroughs
acceptance: the same deterministic compiler used for the Manhattan fixture can generate a tile index and road world covering Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island without manually modeled street grids
representative road distances, widths, direction/lane metadata, intersections, and grades remain source-derived and meter-scale across the citywide build
borough boundaries, bridge connections, highway ramps, and other major cross-tile/cross-borough links are included in automated connectivity diagnostics
a documented route/audit set demonstrates that representative long routes can be traced through the compiled road graph across borough and neighborhood boundaries
compiler diagnostics surface disconnected components, invalid topology, missing tiles, and unresolved grade-separation cases for correction rather than hiding them
